change: apply_rule keeps the frozen float margin and adds its exact value: rank weights 1/d become integer counts on scale lcm(d), so the margin |rank2(score) - rank2(cutoff)| / (2 * total count) is a ratio of integers. Order comparisons of a margin with a release-grid value j/100 use integer cross-multiplication.
calibrate decides feasibility, (sum_g L_g + 1)/(n + 1) <= alpha, from exact group-loss fractions.
read_run accepts a code hash that differs from a frozen protocol only through an entry of this file.

input_path reads the raw and legacy_result inputs from repository copies (.cache/epa/All_DIV_Data.Rdata, downloaded from the pinned EPA commit when absent; chip_forecast_decision.json) before the recorded path, and checks each input against its protocol SHA-256.

frozen_sha maps a published copy listed in results/REDACTIONS.json, whose local paths were replaced by placeholders, to the original hash that freeze records cite; read_run, summarize and the recorded protocol hashes use it.
amendments.unchanged: Cutoffs, rank references, weights, margin grid, alpha, losses, stored float margins, interfaces and every output file format.
amendments.why: Rank margins are k / (2 * scale * G) and can equal a grid value exactly. Under the frozen strict float comparison the last bit of a floating-point sum decided such a release, and that bit can differ between numerical libraries and platforms.
amendments.effect_on_frozen_runs: Re-judging the saved nested folds 0-4 and the common-scale arm A folds from their saved scores, rules and labels changes no calibrated lambda, report count, wrong-report count or released design set.
